$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema: editor autocomplete only, ignored by the loader.

id.description: The sequence id; equals the file name.

babyCarried.description: Whether Papa holds the baby for the whole sequence (he is taken at the start).

kind.description: Papa fights off sleep: micro-sleeps come at a cadence.

durationMs.description: How long the step lasts, in sim ms.

gapMinMs.description: Shortest wait between two micro-sleeps in this step, in sim ms.

gapMaxMs.description: Longest wait between two micro-sleeps in this step, in sim ms.

oneOf.description: A stretch of the sequence where micro-sleeps come every gapMinMs to gapMaxMs.

kind.description: Papa walks to the beat of a track whose tempo changes (story 4.5).

durationMs.description: How long the step lasts, in sim ms. The tempo goes linearly from `bpmStart` at the first beat (`leadInMs`) to `bpmEnd` at the end of the step.

track.description: Id of `feedback.json › beatTracks`: the notes, the count-in tick and the decoy sound.

bpmStart.description: Tempo of the first beat, in beats per minute.

bpmEnd.description: Tempo the ramp reaches at the end of the step, in beats per minute. A beat is placed with the tempo of the beat before it, and the last one falls before the end of the step, so this tempo itself is never played.

leadInMs.description: Wait before the first beat of the count-in, in sim ms from the start of the step.

countInBeats.description: Beats at the start that are only heard (a tap there is free), counted in beats.

windowMs.description: Length of the window around each judged beat, in sim ms, before the tier and the fatigue.

decoyBeats.description: Judged-beat numbers (0-based, count-in excluded) after which an off-beat decoy sits halfway to the next beat. Strictly increasing.

oneOf.description: A stretch of the sequence where Papa taps to a lullaby that slows down.

kind.description: Papa stands still before the bed and leaves at the instant the baby closes his eyes (story 4.6). The step ends when its round is won, not when its time is up.

durationMs.description: The longest a round of this step can take, in sim ms: the rest, the telegraph, the longest wait for the signal, the window and the tolerance must fit in it. A round ends on its result, never on this time.

threatDef.description: Id of the threat (`content/threats/`, aimed at Papa) the sim spawns each round of this step: a `wait`, or a `firm` judged on its `release` (story 4.8).

restMs.description: The breath before each round, from the start of the step (and after each retreat) to the telegraph, in sim ms. A tap in it costs nothing.

slowMo.description: Slow motion for the whole of the round, from the telegraph to the end of the threat's window (story 4.8). Its length is computed from the frozen window, never written here. Absent: the round runs at the world's speed.

timeScale.description: The time scale during the round, from 0.05 (the slowest the sim runs) up to but not including 1 (0.4 = 40 % speed).

returnMs.description: The smoothstep back to normal speed once the round ends, in sim ms.

oneOf.description: A round of patience: wait for the signal, then tap (the Wait response), or lay the baby down (a Firmness judged on its release).

kind.description: Papa sneaks out of the room, holding his breath at every false alarm and answering the real wakes (story 4.9). The step ends on his exit, not when its time is up.

durationMs.description: An estimate of the crossing, in sim ms (like a duel step): the step ends when Papa reaches the exit, never on this time.

exitAnchor.description: Id of an anchor of the level's geometry: the way out. Papa has left once he is within `exitRadiusM` of it.

exitRadiusM.description: How close to the exit anchor Papa must be to have left, in metres.

alertGapMinMs.description: Shortest wait between two alerts of this step, in sim ms.

alertGapMaxMs.description: Longest wait between two alerts of this step, in sim ms, at least `alertGapMinMs`.

realWakePct.description: The chance, in %, that an alert is a real wake (the rest are false alarms). At least 1: with none the baby would never need rocking, and `idle` would win.

falseAlarmDef.description: Id of the threat (`content/threats/`, a `nothing` on the baby) an alert draws when it is a false alarm.

realWakeDef.description: Id of the threat (`content/threats/`, a `parry` on the baby) an alert draws when it is a real wake.

oneOf.description: The infiltration: sneak to the exit while the baby sighs and, sometimes, wakes.

steps.description: The steps, in order. The sequence lasts the sum of their durations.

kind.description: Every step ran to its end with no open response left behind.

Like `stepsDone`, and the baby is laid on the mattress when it ends: Papa is placed over a safe zone at the start, and the combo is cashed in at the end (story 4.8). Needs `babyCarried` and a `retreats` failure.
Any gag during the sequence ends it.

hasSnore.description: Whether the failure makes Papa snore and wakes the baby (+noise).

kind.description: Every miss, decoy tap and stray tap wakes the baby a little; at 100 % he is up.

missWakePct.description: Wake added by a judged beat nobody tapped, in % of the way to awake.

decoyWakePct.description: Wake added by a tap on a decoy, in % of the way to awake.

strayWakePct.description: Wake added by a tap that is on no beat and no decoy (a second tap in a window, a tap between windows), in % of the way to awake.

kind.description: Every gag steps the sequence back one step (the first step stays the first); the failure that makes `maxRetreats` ends it (story 4.6).

maxRetreats.description: How many gags end the sequence: the last one wakes the baby, counted in gags.

zoomPct.description: Extra zoom at full framing, in % of the base zoom.

focusPct.description: How far the camera pans toward Papa at full framing, in % of the way to him.

inMs.description: Time to reach full framing, in sim ms.

outMs.description: Time to come back after the end, in sim ms.

camera.description: The light zoom on Papa while the sequence lasts (sim clock: a pause holds it).

anyOf.description: Id of `feedback.json › loops.sequenceMusic`: the level stems give way to it.

musicLoop.description: The sequence music, or null for no change of music.

labelKey.description: Key of `strings.fr.json` for the bar label (and its accessible name).

fill.description: `opponent` fills in `gauge-warn` (a boss health bar), `player` in `gauge-calm`.

value.description: What the bar shows; `timeLeft` is the time left, `calmLeft` the baby's calm left (100 − his wake, needs a `babyAwake` failure).

anyOf.description: The sequence bar under the timer.

bar.description: The bar under the timer, or null for no bar (and no compact timer).

framing.description: What the client shows around the sequence. The sim ignores it.

started.description: Cue played when the sequence starts.

succeeded.description: Cue played when the sequence is won.

failed.description: Cue played when the sequence is lost.

feedback.description: Cues of `feedback.json` › `cues` the client plays for this sequence.

description: A special sequence: its steps, how it ends and how it looks (stories 4.4, 4.5).
